name: Stage 3 Council Chamber: defeat Thumper

scope_resolution.original_objective: Defeat Thumper and complete Council Chamber.
scope_resolution.stale_row_text: The row still requested an Interpreter re-take and results continuation after both had become available, and retained generic route/collectible/hazard wording after D16 closed the fight objective.
scope_resolution.resolution: D16's fight, mosquito, arena, and defeat work is inherited by reference. The F03 full-stage Any% Interpreter scenario adds the missing initialized-stage-to-results lifecycle.
scope_resolution.no_separate_route_gate: The exit block is gated by Thumper HP <= 20 and the once-only goal latch. No collectible or hazard predicate participates in the statically pinned exit block.

capsule_gate.live_escalation_reason: The retained trace closes the boss mechanism but no retained capsule or declarative scenario covered the full Any% stage through results entry and results exit.

mechanism.resident_fight_overlay: REBUILD/files/LEVEL02/LEVEL.BIN, identified by executing writer PC rather than the mutable region-A head hash
mechanism.thumper_actor: chunk-31 actor slot 1 at 0x8009FE04; HP is signed halfword +0x6e at 0x8009FE72
mechanism.damage_writer: berry_tough_damage_dispatch store at 0x800590e4, two HP per accepted hit
mechanism.once_only_guard: 0x800b4090 skips the block when 0x800823a0 is already nonzero

full_stage_scenario.transport: Interpreter; semantic memory anchor via emulator.advanceUntil, then debugger.resume plus movie.status polling to movie frame 2805
full_stage_scenario.calibration_note: The movie begins during a version-4 neutral/load interval in which scene 2 can already be visible while the reused goal latch and actor slot still contain prior values. Arbitrary frame-1/frame-100 assertions were excluded; HP==50 is the stable semantic anchor.
full_stage_scenario.route_note: This Any% route makes 16 generic damage commits. The separate address-specific D16 trace proves the threshold arc itself is exactly 15 two-point writes from 50 to 20; the stage scenario deliberately asserts >=15 rather than pretending the route cannot deliver an extra hit.

inherited_fight_closure.species_dispatch: Thumper is species 16, dispatch arm 0x8004a5ec, callback 0x8004a0f4 shared with species 22 and 36. The callback only plays SFX 26; it is not the fight driver.
inherited_fight_closure.fight_owner: Shared mover VM plus LEVEL02/LEVEL.BIN overlay logic.
inherited_fight_closure.mosquito: Species 10 uses callback 0x8004a180. Overlay code launches two mosquitoes and rotates a four-direction counter; its one-shot callback raises the launched actor after contact.
inherited_fight_closure.arena: No arena object or geometry trigger: roster+0x14=25 scales to s4=400 and the 1.2.14 sine table bounds X/Z targets to a fixed 12,800-unit circle. Observed maximum 12,800.4 reaches the predicted bound.
inherited_fight_closure.camera_correction: 0x80090bee is cinematic-camera flags, not a defeat flag. Bit 1 requests the suppression gate; bit 0 selects the cinematic camera/letterboxing. The goal latch is a separate store.

evidence_classes.observation: The Interpreter scenario observes scene 2 with HP 50 and then exact once-only goal, cleanup, results-entry, and results-finalizer execution hits.
evidence_classes.inference: The full-stage movie's 16 generic damage commits include at least the 15 commits required by the pinned HP threshold; the separate exact-address trace supplies the 50-to-20 arc.
evidence_classes.causal_binding: The same basic block statically reads Thumper HP, applies the <=20 test and latch guard, starts the cinematic, and stores the goal latch; the live writer PCs execute once on the natural route.
